mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM content_photo p JOIN content_photo_album a ON p.album_id = a.id WHERE p.family_id = #{familyId} AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND a.type = 'public' AND p.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.url AS url, p.description AS description, p.taken_at AS takenAt, p.location AS location, u.nickname AS uploaderName FROM content_photo p JOIN content_photo_album a ON p.album_id = a.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.family_id = #{familyId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 AND ( p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR p.visibility = 'FAMILY' OR (p.visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND p.author_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT album_id AS albumId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_photo WHERE deleted = 0 AND album_id IN #{id} GROUP BY album_id

SELECT p.* FROM content_photo p WHERE p.family_id = #{familyId} AND p.deleted = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_photo_album a WHERE a.id = p.album_id AND a.deleted = 1) ORDER BY p.deleted_at DESC
SELECT * FROM content_photo WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE content_photo SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content_photo SET deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM content_photo WHERE album_id IN #{id}
